pageState.description: Read the current LinkedIn route, authentication gate, challenge, rate-limit, and hydration state.

searchState.description: Verify that LinkedIn reached the requested people or content search route and report its result state.

result_type.description: Expected result type: people, content, or all.

searchResults.description: Extract visible LinkedIn people or content search results without opening or contacting them.

result_type.description: Filter to people, content, or all.

viewport_only.description: Only include results intersecting the viewport.

scrollResults.description: Scroll a LinkedIn search page by one bounded viewport step to hydrate more results.

nudge_up.description: Scroll slightly upward instead of down.

to_top.description: Reset the result page to the top.

profileDetail.description: Extract visible details from the active LinkedIn member profile for research and local greeting drafting.

returns.description: Visible LinkedIn profile details or an explicit gate state.

postDetail.description: Extract the active LinkedIn post, its author, canonical identity, and visible engagement metadata.

returns.description: Visible LinkedIn post details or an explicit gate state.

comments.description: Extract comments currently visible on the active LinkedIn post; never likes, replies, or submits anything.
